scope.normativeClosureText: AW8 has no standalone Cierre line. Evaluate its nine items with inherited §§3.2,18,23,25 and §37.30; do not invent a numeric/model-quality gate.

existingEvidenceBoundary.fake: Deterministic Application/ToolRuntime contracts; not engine evidence
existingEvidenceBoundary.real: Native AW5–7 synthetic component suites including ToolRuntime dispatch, not public product AgentLoop certification
existingEvidenceBoundary.historicalCertifications: Preserved byte-for-byte; no prior PASS reinterpreted
existingEvidenceBoundary.currentBaseline: 172 PASS + 1 unchanged inherited Core harness FAIL, exit1

blockers.required: §§3.2/15/23 current AgentLoop → productive browser tools → ToolRuntime/Policy
blockers.observed: get_default_tools and normal Application composition register no browser_* tools; active_web_factory is optional host seam with no productive caller. Native fixtures use ContractOnlyBrowserTool and private host plans, not a shipping model/tool bridge.
blockers.impact: Cannot certify product multi-step browser E2E by relabeling synthetic host composition as productive AgentLoop.

blockers.required: §18.2–3/§25/AW-INV-007–008,027: availability only after engine + exclusive PUBLIC_ONLY broker proof
blockers.observed: Native engine KNOWN; networkBroker KNOWN(true), but publicOnly and available UNKNOWN by current capability implementation. Basic denied-loopback broker probe is not complete engine-exclusive egress proof.
blockers.impact: Must not force availability, silently downgrade mediation, or advertise browser tools based on installed Chromium. No actual network bypass has been demonstrated.

interpretation: Material implementation/certification prerequisite gap, not a new violation of earlier phase-scoped PASS. Stop rather than expand into unfinished browser activation/network discovery and present component tests as final E2E.
requiredBeforeResumption: Bounded productive browser composition/capability-gated tool surface through the existing AgentLoop and ToolRuntime
Real host-scoped proof of exclusive PUBLIC_ONLY engine mediation and truthful capability discovery
Then independent AW8 tasks/corpus/freeze, never K8/SCF
